title: Nscale Plans $35B IPO Despite 6 Month Flagship Center Delay
summary:
The data center operator is preparing to enter the public markets this month. Nscale is pursuing an initial public offering at a $35 billion valuation even as its primary AI facility is running six months behind schedule after suffering damage from fire and leaks.

Recent investigations reveal that only a small portion of Nscale's $103 billion data center pipeline is currently operational. The buildout has faced further setbacks including equipment failures, power constraints, and alleged labor violations.
